title: Linear size for addition
statement: The language of Boolean-word encodings of addition is recognized by a family of well-formed acyclic Boolean circuits with fan-in at most two such that, on inputs of length $n$, the circuit size is at most $6n+4$.
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definition of the addition language.
